ShortDescription.Value: More options to disable some graphical events

Publish.LongDescription:
When I played for long hours I start to get distracted from graphical events, such as tooltips when your mouse hover's over icons. Or when a big building gets highlighted, because your mouse drives by. Since I am interested in programming/modding I build a solution.
Maybe in the future I would also like to add the ability to disable some sounds in the game, such as the Hospital Helicopter.
The MOD does not affekt gameplay at all.
Even though it is very few people that use it, I think it is pretty cool to see someone else use what you build.
The new options panel is located under Options → Disablehover

ChangeLog.Value: New Feature: Ability to disable raycastevents on buildings, when mouse is over them
